adidas-originals-wales-bonner.title: ADIDAS ORIGINALS BY WALES BONNER
adidas-originals-wales-bonner.description: Established the long-term strategy across communications, social, events and activations to guide the adidas Originals by Wales Bonner collaboration from SS26 to 2028.

xl-recordings-keiyaa-hookes-law-album-re.title: XL RECORDINGS | KEIYAA HOOKE'S LAW ALBUM RELEASE
xl-recordings-keiyaa-hookes-law-album-re.description: Delivered creative and brand consultancy for KeiyAa's Hooke's Law album release. Services included styling direction, relationship management and brand partnership outreach across press imagery and the 'Stupid Prizes' and 'Take It' music videos.

liz-johnson-artur-180-listening-sessions.title: LIZ JOHNSON ARTUR | 180 LISTENING SESSIONS
liz-johnson-artur-180-listening-sessions.description: Facilitated Liz Johnson Artur's feature in Judah Afriyie's High Hopes Sunday Sessions Residency for Devon Turnbull's OJAS Listening Room at 180 Studios.

rachel-jones-hey-maudie.title: RACHEL JONES | HEY MAUDIE
rachel-jones-hey-maudie.description: Articulated the artistic context and future vision for Rachel Jones' opera project 'Hey Maudie'. Established a sustainable positioning for the project's long-term development and global expansion.

dauan-jacari-residency.title: DAUAN JACARI — RESIDENCY
dauan-jacari-residency.description: Designed the brand residency for Dauan Jacari's debut London presentation at Young Space. Facilitated showroom production, film screening event and partnership development.

10k-global.title: 10k GLOBAL
10k-global.description: Creative Advisory for record label 10K Global. Supported MIKE across creative research, curation, tour programming & partnerships.

allen-golder-carpenter-sojourn-camden-ar.title: ALLEN-GOLDER CARPENTER — SOJOURN, CAMDEN ARTS CENTRE
allen-golder-carpenter-sojourn-camden-ar.description: Curated and facilitated Allen-Golder Carpenter's UK debut performance, installation and screening of 'Sojourn' (2025) set to a live score by Richie Culver at Camden Arts Centre.

edition-patrick-frey-lsp-black-ark-book-.title: EDITION PATRICK FREY — L$P BLACK ARK BOOK LAUNCH
edition-patrick-frey-lsp-black-ark-book-.description: Co-curated and organised the book launch of 'Black Ark' presented with Edition Patrick Frey and Marc Asekhame at Cafe OTO. Co-ordinated programming and sonic responses to Lee Scratch Perry's legacy.

ewusie-aw26-cut-from-the-same-cloth-acti.title: EWUSIE | AW26 CUT FROM THE SAME CLOTH | ACTIVATION
ewusie-aw26-cut-from-the-same-cloth-acti.description: Curated and facilitated the EWUSIE 'Cut From The Same Cloth' collection launch at Space Talk, London. Selecting talent, programming and moderating panel conversations.

precious-renee-tucker-telfar.title: PROLOGUE+ | PRECIOUS RENEE TUCKER | TELFAR
precious-renee-tucker-telfar.description: Co-curated and facilitated Precious Renee Tucker's Piano Anatomy and live performance at Telfar New York. A Prologue+ Project (A curatorial initiative co-founded by Cynthia Igbokwe & Moyin Saka) in association with Telfar.

precious-renee-tucker-love-magazine.title: PROLOGUE+ | PRECIOUS RENEE TUCKER
precious-renee-tucker-love-magazine.description: Co-curated, produced and directed Precious Renee Tucker's UK debut live performance at Holy Trinity Church, Dalson. A Prologue+ Project (A curatorial initiative co-founded by Cynthia Igbokwe & Moyin Saka) in association with Office Arca, Bianca Peruzzi and Love Magazine.

mcqueen-reverb.title: MCQUEEN | REVERB
mcqueen-reverb.description: Curated and moderated a conversation and listening session with Nilüfer Yanya for the McQueen 'Reverb' series at the McQueen Flagship Store, London.

xl-recordings-keiyaa-hookes-law.title: XL RECORDINGS | KEIYAA HOOKE'S LAW
xl-recordings-keiyaa-hookes-law.description: Curated and facilitated the artist conversation for KeiyaA's Hooke's Law Album Listening event in London.

ladji-diaby-kunstverein-nuernberg.title: LADJI DIABY | KUNSTVEREIN NUERNBERG
ladji-diaby-kunstverein-nuernberg.description: Wrote exhibition materials for Ladji Diaby's solo exhibition 'No One Has Ever Called Their Child Hunger' at Kunstverein Nuernberg. Shaped curatorial narrative and exhibition language.

prologue-supreme.title: PROLOGUE+ | SUPREME
prologue-supreme.description: Co-curated, produced and facilitated a live performance and film screening featuring Lauren Duffus, SEES00000, DJ Paperworld and Vivian Forever. A Prologue+ Project (A curatorial initiative co-founded by Cynthia Igbokwe & Moyin Saka) supported by Supreme.

blknws-in-residence-music-centre-la.title: BLKNWS IN RESIDENCE | MUSIC CENTRE LA
blknws-in-residence-music-centre-la.description: Curated, produced and facilitated a poetry and screening programme for Khali Joseph's project 'BLKNWS In Residence' at Music Centre LA.

church-of-sound-james-baldwin.title: CHURCH OF SOUND | JAMES BALDWIN
church-of-sound-james-baldwin.description: Co-curated Church of Sound Live Show with David Linx and Glennorah — a live celebration of James Baldwin's record 'A Lover's Question' to celebrate the artist's centenary.

rachel-jones-messiaen-song-cycles-britte.title: RACHEL JONES — MESSIAEN SONG CYCLES BRITTEN PEARS
rachel-jones-messiaen-song-cycles-britte.description: Delivered art direction and curation of the animation for Rachel Jones' paintings in collaboration with Ben Smalley. A project created to accompany Gwen Ann Rand's performance of 'Messiaen's Song Cycles' at the Aldeburgh Festival of Arts.

rachel-jones-a-shorn-root.title: RACHEL JONES | A SHORN ROOT
rachel-jones-a-shorn-root.description: Developed a visual essay for the catalogue of Rachel Jones's 'A Shorn Root' Exhibition at the Long Museum, Shanghai. Overseeing research, graphic design direction, licensing, and copyright coordination.

taka-young-records.title: TAKA | YOUNG RECORDS
taka-young-records.description: Curated, produced and facilitated the UK Live Debut of TAKA — accompanied by NEXCIYA and Mu Tate at Young Space in London.

nuba-ss26-solid-fashion-east.title: NUBA | SS26 'SOLID' | FASHION EAST
nuba-ss26-solid-fashion-east.description: Led creative production for Nuba's SS26 Show 'Solid'. Managed art direction, music, styling, photography, creative assets, press and sponsorship direction.

ola-ebiti-acne-paper-nocturne.title: OLA EBITI | ACNE PAPER (NOCTURNE)
ola-ebiti-acne-paper-nocturne.description: Led visual research for Ola Ebiti and Thibaut Grevet's editorial 'Because the Night' featured in Acne Paper Issue 19, 'Nocturne'.

suutoo-extra-loud.title: SUUTOO | EXTRA / LOUD
suutoo-extra-loud.description: Co-directed the 'Extra / Loud' music video with Suutoo. Oversaw artist relations and video post-production & distribution.

nuba-ss24-smoke.title: NUBA | SS24 'SMOKE'
nuba-ss24-smoke.description: Led the SS24 music direction for NUBA. Facilitated an NTS Radio feature and the runway soundtrack production in collaboration with Wowjean.

10k-global-beware-of-the-monkey.title: 10k GLOBAL | BEWARE OF THE MONKEY
10k-global-beware-of-the-monkey.description: Led creative direction for MIKE. Projects included Ipari Park music video direction, production, post-production, merchandise design and rollout for Beware of the Monkey.

klein-fact-magazine.title: KLEIN | FACT MAGAZINE
klein-fact-magazine.description: Led creative concept, styling and artist supervision for Klein's FACT Magazine cover, shot by Gabriel Moses.

moses-boyd-dark-matter.title: MOSES BOYD | DARK MATTER
moses-boyd-dark-matter.description: Supported the creative direction of Moses Boyd. Developed press kit materials, styling and overseeing artist relations.

royal-academy-of-arts-obi-agwam-reimagin.title: ROYAL ACADEMY OF ARTS — OBI AGWAM — 'REIMAGINING THE CANON' PANEL
royal-academy-of-arts-obi-agwam-reimagin.description: Featured in the Royal Academy of Arts' panel discussion 'Reimagining the Canon' to accompany Royal Academy Schools' 2026 Starr Fellow Obi Agwam's exhibition 'Love Letters to You and Me'.

stone-island-pompeii-utility-album-relea.title: STONE ISLAND — 'POMPEII // UTILITY' ALBUM RELEASE
stone-island-pompeii-utility-album-relea.description: Moderated a conversation between MIKE and Earl Sweatshirt to celebrate the release of their album with SURFGANG, 'POMPEII // UTILITY', in-store at the Stone Island London Flagship.

the-face-earl-sweatshirt-mike-interview.title: THE FACE — EARL SWEATSHIRT & MIKE INTERVIEW
the-face-earl-sweatshirt-mike-interview.description: Commissioned by the FACE Magazine to interview MIKE and Earl Sweatshirt and write the accompanying article to mark the announcement of their 2026 album with SURFGANG, POMPEII // UTILITY.

trippin-new-balance-the-runners-atlas.title: TRIPPIN X NEW BALANCE — THE RUNNERS ATLAS
trippin-new-balance-the-runners-atlas.description: Contributed cultural research for the London Marathon collaboration between Trippin and New Balance. Mapped alternative music history and lost spaces in East and South London to support the 2026 marathon campaign.

josiane-mh-pozi-cura-magazine.title: JOSIANE M.H. POZI | CURA MAGAZINE
josiane-mh-pozi-cura-magazine.description: Researched, interviewed and wrote the Josiane M.H. Pozi feature for Cura Magazine's Issue 44 — 'The Generational Issue'.

dauan-jacari-boy-brother-friend.title: DAUAN JACARI | BOY.BROTHER.FRIEND
dauan-jacari-boy-brother-friend.description: Researched, interviewed and wrote the Dauan Jacari feature for BOY.BROTHER.FRIEND.

nism-self-study-room.title: NISM | SELF-STUDY ROOM
nism-self-study-room.description: Contributed research and curation to NISM's second 'Self Study Room', an experimental temporary learning space at STRYK Studios, Berlin.

rachel-jones-studio-whitechapel-gallery.title: RACHEL JONES STUDIO | WHITECHAPEL GALLERY
rachel-jones-studio-whitechapel-gallery.description: Hosted and moderated 'In Conversation' with Rachel Jones to mark the launch of the 'A Shorn Root' exhibition catalogue.

air-afrique-issue-1-london-stopover.title: AIR AFRIQUE | ISSUE 1: LONDON STOPOVER
air-afrique-issue-1-london-stopover.description: Delivered event facilitation and talk moderation for the London Launch of the magazine Air Afrique.

nuba-boy-brother-friend.title: NUBA — BOY.BROTHER.FRIEND
nuba-boy-brother-friend.description: Researched, interviewed and wrote the NUBA feature for BOY.BROTHER.FRIEND.

locally-grown-c-studios-tv.title: LOCALLY GROWN | C-STUDIOS TV
locally-grown-c-studios-tv.description: Researched, creative directed and programmed a 24-hour channel featuring archival material, lectures, films and pop-cultural content.
